summary.text: Ed Butler is a Republican member of the Tennessee House of Representatives for District 41, where he has served since November 2022, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In the general election, Butler is on the ballot with R. Jason Goodman.

paragraphs.text: Ed Butler's career experience includes owning a business and working as a fire sprinkler contractor.
He has served on the executive board of the Adult & Teen Challenge of The Upper Cumberland and as an assistant Tennessee state coordinator of Run For The Wall.
Butler took office representing District 41 on November 8, 2022.
In the 2023–2024 session he was assigned to the Education Administration, State Government, and Transportation committees.
